answer_1.quote: Open-domain chatbots have a user-centric goal: to provide human with enjoyable user experience.
datasets: 3,608 ten-turn dialogs on movies from Amazon Alexa Prize Challenge

answer_2.quote: Our experiments show that CMADE is able to successfully identify noisy training data and achieves 89.2% in accuracy and 0.787 in Kappa on a test set with unseen expert-rated dialog pairs.

answer_3.quote: We fine tune the pre-trained BERT to learn the dialog feature extractor φ.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 400 dialog pairs for experts to annotate. We ask the question, 'If you were the user, in which scenario would you be more likely to come back and talk to the system again?'
answer_4.guideline: Experts are asked to choose which dialog in a pair would make them more likely to return, focusing on user experience.
